    if not prettyprint:
        indent = ''

    # Build element tag and text
    result = []

    for child in node:
        result.append(self._ETree_to_xml(child, nsmap,
                                         prettyprint=prettyprint,
                                         indent=f'{indent}  '))

    # Add tail and close tag
    tail = node.tail
